full_judgment: (II)	 Because the High Court Division reversed the judgment of the lower appellate court without reversing the material findings of the lower appellate court to the effect that the defendant is in possession of the suit land and the plaintiff has not filed the suit for cancellation of trace map prepared by the executive authority as such, the impugned judgment and order is not a proper judgment of reversal and the High Court Division committed error of law in passing impugned judgment and order as such, the impugned judgment is liable to be set-aside.
